描述_EN: the compact nature of the material comes from the way it is woven. blue background with a multicolored repeating design of interconnecting floral medallions within squares. it could also have been used as a furnishing fabric. it has a second set of warps (longitudinal threads) to bind the design-making wefts (transverse threads). in europe, the term lampas is used for such a weave. there is a selvedge at either side of the length. length of polychrome patterned silk. this term is difficult to translate into chinsese as traditionally textiles have been classified in other ways. the weight and style of the cloth make it suitable for decorating chinese-style book covers, and silk of this type is also used in several different ways on scroll paintings, albums of pictures and folding screens. the chinese term jin, an all-embracing name for any multi-coloured patterned cloth, would be the word used to describe this silk.
描述_ZN: 该材料的紧凑性来自于它的编织方式。 蓝色背景上有一个多色的重复设计，方块内有相互连接的花纹奖章。 它也可能被用作家具织物。 它有第二套经线（纵向线）来绑定设计的纬线（横向线）。 在欧洲，术语Lampas被用于这种编织。 在长度的两边有一个边角料。 长的多色花纹丝绸。 这个术语很难翻译成中文，因为传统上纺织品是以其他方式分类的。 这种布的重量和风格使它适合于装饰中国式的书皮，这种类型的丝绸也以几种不同的方式用于卷轴画、画册和折叠屏风。 中国的术语 "金"，是对任何多色花纹布的全称，将是用来描述这种丝绸的词。
